contexts.text: They who are in mutual love in Heaven, continually advance towards the springtime of their youth...
These things represent the Lord from His first childhood even to adolescence.
On account of this end the Lord insinuates the delight which childhood and youth perceive in the sciences.

The celestial things which are of love are insinuated from first infancy even to childhood, and also to adolescence as man is then and afterwards imbued with sciences and knowledges. If the man is such that he can be regenerated, these sciences and knowledges are filled up with celestial things which are of love and charity, and thus are implanted in the celestial things with which he was gifted from infancy to childhood and adolescence, and thus his outward is conjoined to his inward man. They are first implanted in the celestial things with which he was gifted in adolescence, afterwards in those with which he was gifted in childhood, and at last in those with which he was gifted in infancy.
This treats of the Lord's first combat, which was in His childhood and first youth.
Afterwards a young girl flew to the right cheek.
Afterwards, when he grows up, little by little this good, innocence and peacefulness recede.
When he grows up he is imbued with truths.
Infants there grow up as they advance in intelligence and wisdom.
Affections of good and truth are called infants, girls, young women and daughters, but everywhere with a difference as to state... young woman = affection in which there is charity.

Young women playing with timbrels = affections of truth. Young women are distinguished from virgins by means of innocence, virgins are so called from marriage love, thus those who are in innocence, for marriage love is innocence itself.
As man progresses from infancy and grows up and matures in judgment.

The Angels have no idea of the things of time, as the ages of man, namely infancy, childhood, youth, adult age and old age... Instead of the time of childhood and youth they have the idea of a state of affection of good and truth...

The boys (Esau and Jacob) grew up = the first state, namely of conjunction of good and truth... To grow up, when predicated of good and truth, = the first state of progress... Good and truth... are conceived, are in the womb, are born, grow up, and advance in age even to the last one; their conception, gestation and birth belong to the state of arising; their growing up and advancing in age belong to the state of progress. The state of progress follows from the birth, and is a state of conjunction of good and truth. The first of this state is what is here signified by growing up. This state commences after birth and is continued to the end of life...
Sensual things are those in which children are, scientific things are those in which they are when they grow up.
This is the state of infancy and childhood as to the new life... but the state of its adolescence and youth is...
Spiritual food is knowledge, intelligence and wisdom... and by means of this food Spirits and Angels grow up.

contexts.text: Until Shelah my son grows up = when it is time. To grow up = to be of that age, thus when it is time.

From childhood to adolescence there is opened communication to the interior natural through his learning what is decorous, civil and honest, also through instruction from parents and masters, and by means of studies. From adolescence to youthful age however, communication is opened between the natural and the rational, through his then learning truths and goods of civil and moral life...
Man from infancy up to childhood, and sometimes to the first adolescence, imbues goods and truths through instruction from parents and masters...
Into this state (of reformation) are introduced many who are in the Church from infancy up to adolescence, yet few are regenerated.
As soon as they come to the age of adolescence they suffer themselves to be carried away by the world.

When the age of childhood commences, he by degrees puts off the state of innocence, but is still kept in a state of charity through the affection of mutual charity towards his like, which state with many lasts up to adolescence, he is then among the spiritual Angels, afterwards, because he begins to think for himself...
When a man grows up, and begins to rule himself from himself...
When therefore a man betakes himself to evils, as takes place with most in adolescence.
As soon as he grows up and forms conclusions from sensual things to causes, thus begins to think from the interior natural... But when he becomes a youth, as he then matures... he forms reasons...

Man advances in the things of faith during his regeneration, almost as he does in the truths not of faith, while he is growing up. While he is growing up sensual things are the first plane, afterwards scientific things...

Those who are in the age of adolescence and early youth... believe the doctrinal matters of their Church to be real truths, and hence decide upon falsities, but are not able, as yet, to settle disagreements between those things that are matters of faith within the Church.

Those who are of the Spiritual Church, in their childhood, and afterwards in adolescence, have faith in the doctrinal matters of their own Church, but at that time they have faith from parents and masters.

Afterwards when man grows up and begins to think for himself, so far as he is then carried away by the delights of the love of self and of the world, so far this new voluntary or initiament of a new will is closed; but in so far as he is not carried away by these delights so far it is opened, and also perfected.
The third state is from the twentieth to the sixtieth year of age, which state is a state of intelligence, and is called adolescence, youth and manhood.
That infants grow up in the Heavens. HH 340.

The Spirits are changed with man according to the changes of his affections, hence there are some Spirits with him in infancy, others in childhood, others in adolescence and youth, and others in old age... In adolescence and youth Spirits are present who are in affection of truth and of good, and thence in intelligence, thus who communicate with the Second or Middle Heaven.

That infants as they are perfected in intelligence and wisdom, appear more mature (in Heaven), thus as youths and young men and women, is because intelligence and wisdom are spiritual nourishment itself... Infants in Heaven do not advance in age beyond early youth... CL 411:2.

The difficulty of resisting evils increases in proportion as a man does evils from the will... but this takes place with those who in mature age rush into evils without check, and at the same time reject Divine things from the heart.
If a man in childhood and youth has appropriated to himself any evil by doing it from the delight of the love of it...
As he becomes a child or grows up he comes from that external to interior things, and at length to the reigning love of his father...
The husband appeared in a middle age between adolescence and youth.
The affection of the male... is the affection of knowing in childhood, the affection of understanding in adolescence and early youth, and the affection of being wise from this youth even to old age.
The general states of the life of man are called infancy, childhood, adolescence, youth, and old age.

That I might know for certain that infants (in Heaven) grow and mature in stature as they do in intelligence, it has been granted to speak with some while they were infants and afterwards when they were grown up, and they were seen grown up, in a like stature to that of grown up youths in the world. Compare HH 340:end.
We came as infants into this Heavenly World, and were educated under the Lord's auspices, and after I had become adolescent...
That those who die as infants grow up in Heaven, and when they attain the stature of youths of eighteen years in the world, and of virgins of fifteen years, they stop in it.
That the love of the sex, from which is fornication, commences when a youth begins to think and act from his own understanding, and the tone of his voice begins to be masculine.
The second region of the mind... is opened from childhood to adolescence, and this is effected through thoughts from sciences; and the highest region... from adolescence to youth...
The first state is represented with every man by his state of infancy and childhood even to his youth, adolescence and youth, which is a state of humiliation before his parents.
Infant faith, adolescent faith, adult faith.
Moral life with children even to the first adolescence is natural.
As a youth begins to think from his own mind he is carried towards the south (of the World of Spirits).
They said that the consolation of the Gospel that had been impressed on them from the first adolescence...
This takes place successively as an infant grows, becomes a child, and then a youth.
As they grow up and become their own masters... they leave these Angel guardians.
This Grand Man of the Church passes through its ages like a little or ordinary man, that is to say, from infancy to adolescence, and through this to youth...
Youth = the Ancient Church. AE 724:11.
The days of youth = the times of the Ancient Church.
